note: Designprofilene i KI-bildeassistenten. Hver profil er én prompt (engelsk) som brukes i alle bildepromptene i emnet. {tema} er stedet der bildets tema settes inn; uten {tema} står temaet foran prompten. «custom» har ingen prompt: læreren limer inn sin egen.

styles.label: Happy Pixar
styles.description: Lys og vennlig 3D-animasjonsstil med myke former, pastellfarger og tydelig visuell fortelling.
styles.prompt:
Create a high-quality, happy Pixar-inspired 3D educational illustration that visually communicates the following topic:

{tema}

Visual style:

* Premium cinematic 3D animated movie aesthetic.
* Friendly, expressive and naturally proportioned characters.
* Soft, rounded shapes and polished 3D surfaces.
* Bright, optimistic, welcoming and professional atmosphere.
* Soft pastel colors combined with vibrant blue, turquoise and subtle warm accents.
* Soft global illumination, ambient lighting and subtle glowing effects.
* Gentle shadows and cinematic depth of field.
* Clean, modern and visually engaging educational environments.
* High-quality rendering with exceptional attention to detail.

Composition:

* One clear central visual concept.
* Communicate the topic through visual storytelling, characters, objects and meaningful symbols.
* Use floating 3D icons, subtle holographic elements and glowing connections only when relevant.
* Maintain a balanced, spacious composition with a clear visual hierarchy.
* Avoid unnecessary decorative elements and visual clutter.
* Make the illustration suitable for professional educational materials, online courses and presentations.

Text requirements:

* Prefer absolutely no text in the image.
* Only include text if it adds essential meaning that cannot be communicated visually.
* If text is necessary, use a few short Norwegian words with correct spelling.
* Never include unnecessary headings, labels, paragraphs or decorative typography.
* Let the illustration tell the story.

Technical specifications:

* 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio.
* High-resolution cinematic 3D rendering.
* Bright, clean background.
* Consistent character design and visual language.
* Professional, sophisticated and approachable rather than overly childish.

Avoid: Photorealism, flat vector graphics, dark environments, excessive neon, exaggerated cartoon features, unnecessary text, cluttered compositions, watermarks and overly complex infographics.
